usage: The word 眼 (ngaan5) is used to refer to the eye as a body part.
It can be used to talk about vision and sight-related topics.
眼 can also appear in idiomatic expressions and compound words.
It is singular, but context can indicate singular or plural eyes.
This word is frequently used as the subject or object in sentences.

examples.meaning: You need to protect your eyes.
